#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Independent loop-state construction; same CPU3 and original FP64 tolerances. Preserve v1 failure.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
PY=/home/uranus/miniforge3/envs/tlm_torch/bin/python
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 101 --name P106B_Stage7arW_softdtw_v2_prepare -- "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m scripts.diag_p106b_softdtw_gpu_v2 prepare

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Separate two rolling state tensors. Same exact DP, dtype, shapes, source reference and error gates.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
PY=/home/uranus/miniforge3/envs/tlm_torch/bin/python
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=2
export TRITON_CACHE_DIR="${PWD}/data_cache/p106b_softdtw_gpu_v2_20261113/triton"
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 101 --name P106B_Stage7asW_softdtw_gpu_v2 -- timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=20s 1200s "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m scripts.diag_p106b_softdtw_gpu_v2 actual
